jobs.occupation: Senior Software Test Developer  Automotive HIL/SIL Verification - 20326
jobs.description:
Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.
Job Overview
Assignment Description
Our automotive client in the Mälardalen region is seeking a Senior Software Test Developer to support a major transformation in automotive software verification.
The focus is on expanding Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) and Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) testing capabilities to reduce dependency on physical vehicle testing and improve automation, efficiency, and early-stage verification.
You will collaborate with software developers, system architects, and verification teams to establish modern testing strategies, frameworks, and processes.
What You Will Work On
Drive the introduction and development of HIL and SIL testing capabilities.
Define strategies and best practices for virtual verification and validation.
Establish automated test environments, frameworks, and toolchains.
Identify opportunities for simulation-based testing with development and system teams.
Support teams in transitioning from physical vehicle testing to virtual verification.
Improve software verification processes and testing efficiency.
Analyse existing testing methods and recommend improvements.
Mentor teams and support long-term capability development.

What You Bring
Extensive experience in automotive software testing and verification.
Proven experience with HIL and SIL test environments.
Strong understanding of embedded software development and system verification.
Experience with automated testing frameworks and CI/CD practices.
Experience verifying safety-critical or complex embedded systems.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to drive technical change and support transformation initiatives.
Fluent English, written and spoken.

Meritorious
Experience implementing HIL/SIL verification strategies at scale.
Experience transitioning from physical vehicle testing to simulation-driven validation.
Knowledge of automotive software architectures and modern development methods.
Experience in international, cross-functional development teams.
Familiarity with virtual ECUs, digital twins, simulation frameworks, and model-based development.

jobs.occupation: Senior Project / Program Manager  Financial Crime Prevention (FCP) - 20225
jobs.description:
Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.
Job Overview
Assignment Description
The client is looking for an experienced Senior Project/Program Manager to coordinate multiple EPICs delivered by different teams across various areas of the bank.
You will be responsible for developing clear delivery plans, coordinating deliverables, and identifying dependencies and risks across the different EPICs. From late January/early February 2027, you will also take over the program management responsibility for an ongoing Financial Crime Prevention (FCP) program as the current Program Manager retires.
The program includes implementing new customer screening and transaction monitoring systems, upgrading existing systems, migrating systems to a new container platform, and regulatory reporting.
What You Will Work On
Coordinate multiple EPICs across different teams and business areas.
Develop clear plans and coordinate deliveries across EPIC owners.
Identify, track, and manage dependencies, risks, and delivery challenges.
Take over program management responsibilities for the ongoing FCP program.
Coordinate implementation of customer screening and transaction monitoring systems.
Manage system upgrades, container platform migrations, and regulatory reporting initiatives.
Align stakeholders and ensure progress across parallel workstreams.

What You Bring
Extensive experience in project and/or program management.
Experience coordinating multiple projects or workstreams.
Strong skills in dependency management, risk identification, and delivery planning.
Fluent Swedish and English, both written and spoken.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

Meritorious
Previous experience with regulatory projects.
Experience within Financial Crime Prevention (FCP).
Experience in banking and financial services.
Experience managing complex IT programs involving multiple teams and systems.

jobs.description:

With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.
 Job Overview
Assignment Description
We are looking for an experienced Expediter to support two ongoing Oil & Gas projects. You will monitor and follow up on supplier progress across Europe, helping ensure equipment and materials are delivered according to project schedules and requirements.
You will work alongside an experienced expediter who will provide project onboarding and guidance, with the aim of sharing the workload.
The role does not require working from the Finspång office and involves regular travel to supplier locations across Europe.
What You Will Work On
Monitor and follow up on supplier progress for ongoing Oil & Gas projects.
Track manufacturing and fabrication activities against project schedules.
Inspect or follow up on equipment under fabrication, including process equipment, materials, welding, and electrical installations.
Identify delays and potential delivery risks and coordinate follow-up actions with suppliers.
Collaborate with project teams and suppliers to support timely equipment delivery.
Share workload and coordinate activities with an experienced expediter.
Travel to supplier locations across Europe as required.

What You Bring
At least 10 years of experience in quality or engineering within the Oil & Gas industry.
Previous experience in expediting for Oil & Gas projects.
Experience with inspection or follow-up of equipment under fabrication, process equipment, materials, welding, and/or electrical installations.
Proficiency in English.
Strong supplier follow-up, coordination, and communication skills.
Willingness to travel regularly across Europe.

Meritorious
Experience with supplier quality assurance and quality control.
Experience with manufacturing inspections.
Knowledge of project delivery schedules and fabrication processes.

 Job Overview

Experience with C++ and/or Python through academic projects, internships, or professional work.

Good understanding of embedded systems, software development, and hardware-software integration.

Familiarity with sensors, electronics, and basic laboratory equipment such as multimeters and oscilloscopes.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a hands-on engineering mindset.

Good communication skills and ability to collaborate in a multidisciplinary engineering team.

Proficiency in written and spoken English.

Experience with embedded Linux, particularly NVIDIA Jetson platforms.

Familiarity with RGB, infrared, or depth cameras and sensor integration.

Basic understanding of computer vision, machine learning, or AI model deployment on embedded devices.

Experience with real-time processing, performance optimization, or edge AI applications.

Curiosity and enthusiasm for AI, embedded technologies, and solving real-world engineering challenges.

A proactive attitude, willingness to learn, and ability to take ownership of technical tasks.

Comfort working in a small, fast-moving team where you can make a meaningful contribution.

About the role
We are looking for a Data Center Engineer to support the installation, operation and maintenance of data center infrastructure. You will help ensure that servers, storage, networks and supporting facilities operate securely and reliably.
You will work closely with infrastructure teams, facilities specialists and external vendors to resolve incidents, deliver changes and maintain service availability.
Key responsibilities
Install, configure and maintain servers, storage systems and network equipment.

Perform rack-and-stack activities, hardware replacements and structured cabling.

Monitor infrastructure health, investigate faults and coordinate incident resolution.

Support operating system maintenance, patching and hardware lifecycle management.

Carry out approved changes using documented procedures, validation checks and rollback plans.

Support backup, recovery and disaster recovery activities.

Maintain asset inventories, rack layouts, cabling records and operational documentation.

Coordinate with facilities teams on power, cooling, environmental monitoring and physical security.

Work with vendors on maintenance, equipment deliveries and hardware support.

Follow access controls, safety procedures and change management processes.

Participate in scheduled maintenance and on-call support where required.

Required qualifications
Relevant experience in data center operations, infrastructure support or a similar technical role.

Hands-on knowledge of server hardware, storage and networking fundamentals.

Experience with Linux and/or Windows Server environments.

Understanding of virtualization technologies such as VMware, Hyper-V or KVM.

Familiarity with fiber and copper cabling, rack infrastructure and hardware diagnostics.

Understanding of incident management, change management and operational documentation.

Strong troubleshooting, communication and organizational skills.

Ability to work independently and collaborate with technical teams and vendors.

Professional working proficiency in English.

Preferred qualifications
Experience with SAN/NAS storage, backup platforms or disaster recovery testing.

Familiarity with infrastructure monitoring and Data Center Infrastructure Management (DCIM) tools.

Scripting or automation experience using PowerShell, Bash, Python or Ansible.

Exposure to cloud connectivity and hybrid infrastructure.

Relevant certifications in networking, servers, virtualization or IT service management.

Hello Clean is hiring reliable cleaners in Stockholm — and we welcome international students already living in Sweden.
This is Hello Clean in Stockholm.

👉 Apply here: https://helloclean.se/jobb-student-stadare/

Who are you?
You can communicate in Swedish or English
You need to be thorough and like to give your customers that little extra ✨

Importante to note:
You must have a valid work permit in Sweden. EU/EES students have the automatic right to work here. Non-EU/EES students with a residence permit can in most cases work alongside their studies without any hour restrictions — check your permit card for details.

Experience from service-related jobs

A starting salary of 170SEK/hour + paid vacation.

You will also get work clothes, Service-ID and of course support from your colleagues and area manager. ISO 9001 and 14001 certified
Personnel insurance
Liability insurance
Service pension
